Calories in Callos a la madrileña (Madrid-style tripe stew)

A serving of Madrid-style tripe stew (300 g) has 516 kcal, 172 kcal per 100 g: 42.6 g protein, 15.4 g carbs and 31.7 g fat. Below: what a real serving weighs, where the calories come from and how it compares with similar dishes.

Updated 15 October 2026·Figures from the Fotocal database

How big is a real serving?

Fotocal counts Madrid-style tripe stew as 1 serving, 300 g, the way it is usually served in Spain: 516 kcal. Half of that is about 258 kcal; a serving and a half, about 774.

AmountGramskcal
100 g100 g172

Where the calories come from

Of every 100 kcal in Madrid-style tripe stew, about 55 come from fat, 33 come from protein, 12 come from carbs.

Protein 33%Carbs 12%Fat 55%

What is in a serving

The serving is built from these ingredients, gram by gram:

  • 150 g cooked beef tripe
  • 40 g cooked chickpeas
  • 30 g chorizo
  • 20 g black pudding (morcilla)
  • 30 g tomato sauce (tomate frito)
  • 15 g onion (stewed)
  • 8 g olive oil
  • 7 g water

Frequently asked questions

How many calories are in Madrid-style tripe stew?

A serving of Madrid-style tripe stew (1 serving, 300 g) has 516 kcal: 42.6 g protein, 15.4 g carbs and 31.7 g fat. Per 100 g it is 172 kcal.

Where do the calories in Madrid-style tripe stew come from?

Mostly from fat: about 55 of every 100 kcal. The rest is protein 33%, carbs 12%.

How many calories are in half a serving or a bigger one?

Half a serving (150 g) is about 258 kcal; a serving and a half (450 g), about 774 kcal. For any other amount, weigh it and multiply the grams by 172, then divide by 100.
